meta.engine: 4-player Catan, identical heuristic bots; Player 0's opening strategy is the only asymmetry; board re-randomized every game. See METHODS.md for full rules, simplifications (no player-to-player trading), and strategy definitions.

strategy_definitions.baseline: Control. Identical to the heuristic used by players 1-3: score each legal intersection as (sum of adjacent dice pips) + 1.5 * (distinct adjacent resource types, desert excluded); pick the highest score. Ties broken by lowest vertex id (deterministic).
strategy_definitions.max_pips: Pick the legal intersection with the highest sum of adjacent dice pips (desert excluded, no diversity bonus). Applied independently to both draft picks. Ties broken by lowest vertex id.
strategy_definitions.diversity: First pick: the legal intersection adjacent to the most distinct resource types (desert excluded); ties broken by higher pip sum, then lowest vertex id. Second pick: the legal intersection maximizing the number of distinct resource types covered by the UNION of both picks' adjacent hexes; ties broken by higher pip sum of the second vertex, then lowest vertex id.
strategy_definitions.port_seeking: Prefer intersections touching a port (any of the 9 fixed ports: 4x 3:1, 5x 2:1): among legal intersections, pick a port vertex first; among port vertices (or if none are legal) pick the highest adjacent pip sum. Ties broken by lowest vertex id.
strategy_definitions.wheat_ore: Prefer city-building resources: score each legal intersection by the sum of adjacent dice pips on WHEAT and ORE hexes only; ties broken by higher total adjacent pip sum (all resources), then lowest vertex id.
